pr_title: Add flag to listen on STDIN close
pr_body:
# ↪️ Pull Request

This allows using Parcel as asset builder in Phoenix pipelines which requires
builder to close when STDIN closes.

## 💻 Examples

Just run:

```sh
echo | parcel watch --watch-for-stdin file.js
```

## 🚨 Test instructions

The same as in example. The application should just stop and exit.

## ✔️ PR Todo

- [ ] Added/updated unit tests for this change
- [x] Filled out test instructions (In case there aren't any unit tests)
- [x] Included links to related issues/PRs

Close #2710
pr_comments: Added that option to `parcel serve` as well.

issue_context.title: Add option to/watch for stdin close
issue_context.body:
# 🙋 feature request

I want to use Parcel together with my [Phoenix](https://phoenixframework.com) project. This projects allows you to define assets builder for you by simply stating how to start it, however it will not send signal to the watching process when it exists, it will just close `stdin` and will hope that process notice that and will close itself.

## 💁 Possible Solution

- listen on `stdin` and close itself when those close;
- or add flag similar to Webpack `--watch-stdin` that will enable such behaviour

## Current behaviour

```
true | parcel watch index.js
```

Will keep running

## Expected behaviour

```
true | parcel watch --watch-stdin index.js
```

Will end immediately.

review_comments: Should we also add this to the `serve` command?
I do not use `serve` command so I didn't know if this would be useful for anyone, but it can be added.
